name: Mobile home
description:
1. You asked me to review the router because **Activity is the new mobile home**.
2. I found the mobile→Activity redirect already implemented in `src/router/navigate.js` (guards `root`/`home` to `activity`), and routes under `src/router/index.ts` correct.
3. I found dead `mobile` route leftovers: a `mobile` route builder, `isMobileMode` getter (always `false`), `apps.openMobile()` (would throw), and two unreachable guard branches.
4. I proposed one file change, `src/router/navigate.js`, removing those stale references and collapsing the dead branches, without touching the Activity-as-home behavior.
5. Still open: whether to delete the `mobile` API or repoint it to `activity`, and optional follow-ups on the mobile width threshold (1024 vs 768) and `ui.isMobile` init timing.

messages.content: Activity will be the new mobile home. review router.
